If `WarningIcon` changed behaviour, three components in the patient chart would be affected. All three render it inside the order basket item tile to show an order error, next to the error message. Each is a basket-item component, so the change would show up in the basket's error state.

1. **Drug order basket tile** (`esm-patient-medications-app`): `OrderBasketItemTile` renders `<WarningIcon size={16} />` at line 91 when `orderBasketItem.orderError` is set. This is the most exposed use because it also renders for discontinued and free-text drug orders.
2. **General order basket tile** (`esm-patient-orders-app`): `OrderBasketItemTile` renders `<WarningIcon size={16} />` at line 38 for the same error state.
3. **Lab order basket tile** (`esm-patient-tests-app`): `LabOrderBasketItemTile` renders `<WarningIcon size={16} />` at line 46 for the same error state.

The icon is defined in `openmrs-esm-core` at `icons.tsx:848`, and `AllergiesIcon` is an alias of it (line 859). Nothing in the patient chart imports `AllergiesIcon`, so it adds no further patient chart exposure. The `WarningIcon` mocks in `esm-styleguide` (lines 103 and 102) would also need to match any behaviour change in tests. Two other core files use the icon: the date picker icon (`date-picker-icon.component.tsx:17`) and the login app's location picker (`location-picker-view.component.tsx:152`). Neither is in the patient chart.

I could not confirm the `WarningIcon` definition's own behaviour beyond the code above. The `Icon` component it wraps is not in the results.
